---
pagetitle: "Bimandra Djaafara"
title: "Publications"
toc: false
---

```{r bibArticle}
#| results: asis
#| echo: false

RefManageR::BibOptions(check.entries = FALSE,
                       style = "markdown",
                       bib.style = "numeric",
                       sorting = "ydnt",
                       max.names = 99)

bib <- RefManageR::ReadBib("publications.bib", .Encoding = "UTF-8",
                           check = 'warn')

# All entries (articles and preprints)
bibArticle <- bib

# Capture output and highlight author name
output <- capture.output(print(bibArticle))
output <- paste(output, collapse = "\n")  # collapse to single string for multi-line patterns
output <- gsub("B\\. A\\. Djaafara", "**B. A. Djaafara**", output)
output <- gsub("B\\. Djaafara", "**B. Djaafara**", output)
output <- gsub("B\\. A\\. Djafaara", "**B. A. Djafaara**", output)  # alternate spelling
output <- gsub("B\\. Djafaara", "**B. Djafaara**", output)  # alternate spelling
output <- gsub("\\s*\\(visited on [^)]+\\)", "", output)  # remove "visited on" dates
output <- gsub("URL:\\s*\\[.+?\\]\\(.+?\\)", "", output, perl=TRUE)  # remove redundant URL links (DOI is enough)
output <- gsub("\\.\\s*\\.", ".", output)  # clean up double periods
output <- gsub("(https://www\\.medrxiv\\.org)", "**[Preprint]** \\1", output)  # mark preprints
cat(output)
```
